symptom: `MDL067` names two unrelated diagnostics: the ERROR for `create or modify … if not exists` (contradictory guards) and the INFO note that a bare `commit $X;` now runs events. A user filtering or looking up MDL067 cannot tell which one they have
cause: Rule ids are string literals at each `addViolation` / `RuleID:` site with no registry, so a later rule picked an id already in use and nothing failed
insight: The guard error moved to MDL085 (a gap no branch's history ever used); the commit note kept MDL067 because `fmt --upgrade`, mdl/upgrade and the released CHANGELOG already name it for that note. Before picking a rule id, grep the whole tree (`grep -rhoE 'MDL0[0-9]{2}' --include=*.go --include=*.md`) and `git log --all -S'MDLnnn'` — there is no `mxcli help <rule-id>` and no central list to consult. The guard test now also asserts the old id is never reported
